ModMetaData.name: More Storylike Traits - Français (unofficial)
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
UNOFFICIAL. This translation is published without the original author's explicit consent. If the original author contacts me to request its removal, I undertake to take it down promptly.
French names and descriptions for the traits and thoughts of [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2941176778]HYP's More Storylike Traits (Continued)[/url].
[h2]What it translates[/h2]
All 53 traits and 31 thoughts: labels and descriptions, with the rarity colours kept. It adds text only, no code and no Defs, and does nothing without the mod above.
The traits are biographies, so the French is rewritten rather than translated word for word: the original English is machine-made over the jokes of one Chinese forum, and a literal pass would lose the person. Pronouns follow the pawn's gender through the game's own arguments.
[h2]Compatibility[/h2]
Requires RimWorld 1.6 and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2941176778]HYP's More Storylike Traits (Continued)[/url], loaded before this one. The original [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2012787971]HYP's More Storylike Traits[/url] has the same package id and works as well, but stops at 1.3. English is left to the original's own text; only French is injected.
[h2]Known limits[/h2]
Not yet tested in game. The French descriptions are our rewrite, so they say slightly more than the original English, and they replace it when French is selected.
[hr][/hr]
[h2]If I go quiet[/h2]
If I do not answer within a reasonable time after being contacted, anyone may freely update this or any other of my mods, including publishing a continuation of it. All credit must be preserved.
[h2]AI-generated[/h2]
The French text was written and checked with Claude (Anthropic), under human direction.
[h2]Thanks[/h2]
To 七彩型七色 (Hyperion-c) and DarthCY, who made the original, and to liweilin111 (Lin), who keeps it running. Every trait, number and idea is theirs. Thanks also to the authors of RimWorld's translation tools, and to the Pickle and RimLogging projects used for development only, never a dependency. See ATTRIBUTION.md.
